# PhotoQuizzer

> PhotoQuizzer is a free Android app that converts photos of study notes into interactive quizzes and flashcards using Google Gemini AI.

PhotoQuizzer lets students snap a photo of handwritten or printed study notes and instantly receive a 5-question multiple-choice quiz plus 5 flashcards generated by Google's Gemini AI. Key facts:

- Platform: Android 7.0+ (APK direct download; not on Play Store yet)
- Price: Free. 5 free credits on signup; more credits via rewarded ads or promo codes
- Core features: AI quiz generation from note photos, flashcards with flip interface, quiz scoring with explanations, light/dark themes, offline-connection awareness
- Privacy: user accounts secured with email authentication and row-level security; note photos are processed by the Gemini API to generate quizzes
- Developer: Orbits3X
- Official site and download: https://photoquizzer.netlify.app
- Direct APK: https://photoquizzer.netlify.app/Photo-Quizzer-v1.1.apk
